expectation: Cytoplasmic granular signal in neutrophils (and some monocytes). These are scattered single cells, more common in stroma, near vessels and in inflamed or necrotic areas, and may cluster in neutrophil-rich regions. A minority of cells overall, varying between images.
notes: MPO lights discrete single cells, cell-sized and granular, scattered through the stroma, and some images have dense clusters. The signal is not haze or a copy of the nuclear density, and the background is dark. This looks like a specific neutrophil population.
observed: A: discrete yellow dots scattered across most images, dense clusters in a few (top row), sparse in others. B/C: bright, separate cell-sized granular blobs scattered among the nuclei, mostly between the dense nuclear bands. D: granular cytoplasm next to a nucleus.
why: A distinct, scattered, granular cytoplasmic population with neutrophil-like distribution and varying density between images, not tissue-wide haze.
